details: Large Ethereum holders, including institutions like Bitmine and BlackRock's iShares Ethereum Trust, are actively accumulating ETH. Bitmine's holdings reached 5.21 million ETH (worth approximately $12.1 billion). This significant institutional accumulation, coupled with ETH rising above its realized price, is being interpreted by some analysts as a sign of a "crypto spring" and growing long-term confidence in Ethereum.
title: Ethereum Whales Accumulate ETH, Signalling "Crypto Spring"

details: The broader crypto market is experiencing a bullish trend, with many tokens showing gains. Bitcoin has been trading above $81,000, briefly touching $82,000. Factors such as continued ETF inflows and whale accumulation are contributing to this positive sentiment, despite some caution due to geopolitical uncertainties. Bernstein maintains a bullish 2026 Bitcoin target of $150,000.
title: Bitcoin Holds Above $81K Amid Bullish Market Trend

details: The US Senate Banking Committee has released the full 309-page text of the Digital Asset Market Clarity Act, ahead of a scheduled markup on Thursday, May 14. This bill aims to provide regulatory clarity for stablecoins and digital assets, though it faces debate with opposition from labor unions and the American Bankers Association, while industry players like Coinbase see essential positive elements.
title: US Senate Unveils Draft of Crypto Market Structure Bill (CLARITY Act)

details: Ethereum's price has seen a downside correction from the $2,380 level and is showing bearish indicators. ETH failed to sustain above $2,365 and is currently trading below its 100-hourly Simple Moving Average, suggesting potential for further decline if it breaks below $2,300.
title: Ethereum Price Faces Resistance, Dips Below Key Level

details: Chainlink (LINK) has seen a significant price increase of over 3% due to growing adoption of its Cross-Chain Interoperability Protocol (CCIP) and a supply squeeze. Following a recent LayerZero exploit, over $1 billion in DeFi protocols migrated to CCIP, boosting LINK's utility. Whale and ETF accumulation further reduced available supply.
title: Chainlink Surges on Increased CCIP Adoption
